notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list places a tower here, as 'eulonia' (compiler's label). The note 'topo 1955' is unexplained and the list's header and footer have no legend for it; the story labels the 1955 map link as our inference. The list cites 1:100,000 USGS topo maps as a source for its towers in general, not as the discovery method for this entry. Units: the list gives no unit; the 17 is read as feet, which matches the record's 5.2 m. Searched the McIntosh County Historic Resources Survey Phase One and Phase Two PDFs for lookout or fire-tower references: they mention only church and building towers, so nothing here. The GFC McIntosh County office is '1/4 mile east of Eulonia, GA on GA Hwy 99' per the GFC county contacts page; that is the office, not the tower, and was not used. NHLR: the Georgia page's full list of 29 names was read on 2026-10-21; none is Eulonia. No build, staffing, fire or current-status source found. Access, status and visit fields stay unknown.
